verdict.rationale: Synctera's docs list a capability that "handles remote deposit capture (RDC) transactions," which covers the check-deposit-with-image-capture half of the story, though only as a single-line mention. Nothing in the evidence shows programmatic check issuance, such as an API to write or mail outbound paper checks. Missing for 10: programmatic check issuance/sending, detailed RDC docs (image capture flow, endorsement, holds/returns), independent or hands-on corroboration.
